function: Symbol detection in the delay-Doppler domain of OTFS under channel estimation error, with the OAMP detector unfolded into a network with learnable parameters (pp. 1, 3).
system: OTFS link, antennas not stated, no RIS; N = M = 8 frame, 15 kHz subcarrier spacing, 4 GHz carrier, 500 km/h user speed (p. 4).
method: Deep unfolding of OAMP into T = 10 layers with three learnable scalars per layer (gamma, theta, beta); supervised training, 200 epochs, Adam (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated sparse multipath DD channel, P = 3 or 4 paths, random delay and fractional Doppler indices, Gaussian estimation error; no standardized or measured channel (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Train: 10000 samples per epoch, SNR 10-30 dB, fixed estimation error. Test: 3000 samples over SNR 10-30 dB; N = M = 8, 16, 32 reported (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: OAMP detector [11]; learned: EP-Net [14], a model-driven expectation-propagation OTFS detector (p. 4).
metrics: BER versus SNR under different channel-estimation error variances, numbers of paths, and frame sizes (pp. 4-5).
complexity: O((2MN)^3) per iteration, same as OAMP and EP-Net; ML detector exponential; 3T learnable parameters in total (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "The Doppler index and delay index of each path are randomly generated with kmax = 3 and lmax = 6, respectively."
q2_support: p. 4: "we generate 3000 data pairs with different SNR ranging from 10dB to 30dB to test the network"
q3_support: p. 4: "compare the BER performance of MD-OAMP, OAMP detector [11] and EP-Net [14] detector"
q4_support: p. 4: "the total number of learnable parameters is 3T"
q5_support: p. 4: "Each sample was independently generated according to the OTFS modulation scheme introduced in section II"
notes: Area 4: detection in the DD domain of OTFS (deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned). q1: own random-path simulator, no 3GPP or measured channel. q2: only an SNR sweep on freshly generated samples; the paper does not say that weights trained at N = M = 8 are reused at N = M = 16 or 32, nor at another error variance. q3: OAMP [11] is non-learned, EP-Net [14] is an earlier learned OTFS detector, compared in BER (Fig. 4). q5: no code or data link.
